summary: Morningstar, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its Board approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.50 per share, payable July 31, 2026 to holders of record July 10, 2026. This is a routine capital allocation event with no special situation characteristics such as a takeover, restructuring, or strategic review. The filing includes only a press release as an exhibit and does not mention any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformative corporate event. As a regular dividend declaration, it does not meet the criteria for any special-situation category.
